AUTH-003.definition: ## AUTH-003 — Historical report vs current verified baseline

PROD-007.definition: ## PROD-007 — Equipment profiles and explainable day adjustment

LEG-TRN-001.definition: **LEG-TRN-001 MUST** preserve built-in A/B/C training presets as built-in Equipment/Profile presets.

LEG-TRN-002.definition: **LEG-TRN-002 MUST** preserve the existing push/pull/legs/core plan capability and all legacy plan exercise entries unless a mapped correction is documented.

LEG-TRN-004.definition: **LEG-TRN-004 MUST** preserve switching between built-in plans without silently losing historical check-ins or weights.

LEG-EXR-001.definition: **LEG-EXR-001 MUST** preserve teaching access for the legacy plan actions.

EXR-001.definition: **EXR-001 MUST** preserve semantic legacy→canonical mapping, not only aggregate counts.

EXR-002.definition: **EXR-002 MUST** preserve, where present: exercise name, target muscles, sets/reps, tempo, breathing, rest, starting-weight information, standard form, common errors, safety guidance, and teaching media metadata.

VID-001.definition: **VID-001 MUST** treat media availability and semantic correctness as separate properties.

VID-003.definition: **VID-003 MUST** keep text teaching usable when video is unavailable.

VID-004.definition: **VID-004 MUST** preserve fallback paths where feasible:

LEG-VOICE-001.definition: **LEG-VOICE-001 MUST** preserve the legacy voice companion capability.

VOI-002.definition: **VOI-002 MUST** preserve emotion-aware delivery rather than flattening all output to one prosody.

VOI-003.definition: **VOI-003 MUST** correctly stop/cancel speech on navigation, visibility/lifecycle changes, and explicit voice-off.

VOI-004.definition: **VOI-004 MUST** explicitly degrade when speech APIs are unavailable; text remains usable.

VOI-005.definition: **VOI-005 SHOULD** keep local speech as the reliable baseline. Cloud TTS may be optional only if secrets stay server-side and local fallback remains.

LEG-BOJI-001.definition: **LEG-BOJI-001 MUST** preserve the companion as a living interactive product feature, not reduce it to a static avatar.

LEG-BOJI-002.definition: **LEG-BOJI-002 MUST** preserve the verified interaction classes from V1 where present: skins/appearance choice, movement, emotions, animation, dragging, voice, click interaction, and Photo Pet personalization. Implementation may be redesigned, but capability must not silently disappear.

BOJI-MOT-001.definition: **BOJI-MOT-001 MUST** preserve ambient motion capability such as blink/idle/stretch/sleep/light movement.

BOJI-MOT-002.definition: **BOJI-MOT-002 MUST** drive event motion from verified product events such as set completion, rest end, workout completion, PR, and milestones.

BOJI-MOT-003.definition: **BOJI-MOT-003 MUST** pause or safely reduce noncritical animation when hidden/backgrounded or reduced-motion is requested.

LEG-PHOTO-001.definition: **LEG-PHOTO-001 MUST** preserve Photo Pet/local user image personalization.

LEG-FOOD-003.definition: **LEG-FOOD-003 MUST** preserve photo-AI as an optional input path, governed by `04-DATA-TRUTH.md`.

LEG-FOOD-004.definition: **LEG-FOOD-004 MUST** preserve useful food-history convenience such as recent/history/high-frequency reuse when verified in the baseline.

LEG-RUN-002.definition: **LEG-RUN-002 MUST** label calorie burn as estimated.

LEG-RUN-003.definition: **LEG-RUN-003 MUST** preserve a usable map/route experience with an honest offline/denied-GPS fallback; absence of live map tiles must not fabricate route data.

LEG-KNW-001.definition: **LEG-KNW-001 MUST** preserve the long-form knowledge capability and science/knowledge media capability.

LEG-DAT-001.definition: **LEG-DAT-001 MUST** preserve useful historical views such as streak/calendar/body-weight/progress visualizations, with V2 redesign allowed.

LEG-DAT-002.definition: **LEG-DAT-002 MUST** preserve export/import capability but rebuild it under V2 schema/security rules.

DAT-001.definition: **DAT-001 MUST** use stable semantic IDs. Legacy array index is migration input only.

TRN-002.definition: **TRN-002 MUST NOT** represent “complete this set” as only an exercise-level boolean.

TRN-003.definition: **TRN-003 MUST** store real set-level values sufficient for progression, including where relevant:

TRN-004.definition: **TRN-004 MUST** prevent custom-exercise completion from satisfying planned-exercise completion.

TRN-005.definition: **TRN-005 MUST** make critical set/workout persistence commit before success acknowledgement.

PRG-001.definition: **PRG-001 MUST NOT** invent a recovery score from unavailable signals.

PRG-002.definition: **PRG-002 MUST** keep progression suggestions explainable and user-confirmed.

PRG-004.definition: **PRG-004 MUST** use a conservative double-progression style as the default progression suggestion:

TRN-006.definition: **TRN-006 MUST** implement Equipment Profiles while preserving A/B/C as built-in presets.

TRN-007.definition: **TRN-007 MUST** implement `调整今天` with deterministic substitution constraints based on movement pattern, muscles, equipment and goal. An LLM MUST NOT decide exercise equivalence.

TRN-008.definition: **TRN-008 MUST** persist enough active-session recovery state to offer recovery after reload/process interruption, including at minimum session identity/status, current exercise/set, timestamps, last committed state and active rest end time.

FOOD-002.definition: **FOOD-002 MUST** route AI/photo output into `FoodDraft` before any committed `MealRecord`.

FOOD-003.definition: **FOOD-003 MUST** require explicit user confirmation before AI-derived food identity/portion/nutrition becomes a committed meal fact.

FOOD-004.definition: **FOOD-004 MUST NOT** fabricate macronutrients from calories or rescale macros merely to force calorie consistency.

FOOD-005.definition: **FOOD-005 MUST** itemize mixed meals when multiple components are detected/entered.

FOOD-006.definition: **FOOD-006 MUST** distinguish identity confidence, portion estimate, and nutrition source; one model confidence value must not masquerade as calibrated probability.

FOOD-007.definition: **FOOD-007 MUST** use this logical photo pipeline:

FOOD-008.definition: **FOOD-008 MUST** preserve explicit user measurements (for example “chicken 150g”) as `USER_PROVIDED`; AI MUST NOT silently re-guess them.

FOOD-009.definition: **FOOD-009 MUST** make asynchronous food/search/AI operations latest-result-wins using cancellation and request ownership (for example AbortController + generation/request id + owner view). Stale results MUST be discarded.

FOOD-010.definition: **FOOD-010 SHOULD** debounce remote food search in the ~300–400ms range, cancel superseded requests, and keep local search responsive.

FOOD-011.definition: **FOOD-011 MUST** avoid using full image base64 as an unbounded cache key/store. If AI result caching is used, use a fingerprint/hash with an explicit LRU/byte budget.

KNW-001.definition: **KNW-001 MUST** maintain a claim/source registry for evidence-bearing knowledge content. A claim record SHOULD identify claimId, text/scope, sourceIds, evidence/confidence type, review date and safety class where applicable.

KNW-002.definition: **KNW-002 MUST NOT** present legacy `[A]/[B]` style labels as formal evidence grades unless a real source registry supports those grades. Unverifiable claims must be downgraded or clearly marked, not backfilled with invented citations.

KNW-003.definition: **KNW-003 MUST** label nutrition defaults/targets as estimates rather than precise prescriptions. Any inherited heuristics such as kcal/kg, protein/kg or ml/kg MUST show their assumption status and remain user-adjustable.

KNW-004.definition: **KNW-004 MUST** support an onboarding nutrition intent that can be at least: log-only, maintain, gain, lose, or custom. The system target is an initial estimate, not a medical or immutable prescription.

DAT-010.definition: **DAT-010 MUST** store absolute timestamps using epoch/UTC representation.

DAT-011.definition: **DAT-011 MUST** use a unified `localDateKey()` for user calendar grouping.

DAT-012.definition: **DAT-012 SHOULD** preserve timezone offset/context at event time when needed to prevent travel reinterpretation.

DAT-020.definition: **DAT-020 MUST** derive rest/timers from wall-clock timestamps (`startedAt`, `endsAt`), not decrementing counters.

DAT-030.definition: **DAT-030 MUST** treat legacy `boji_v7` as read-only for the entire V2 runtime.

DAT-031.definition: **DAT-031 MUST** make V1→V2 import user-initiated after a preflight summary.

DAT-033.definition: **DAT-033 MUST** quarantine ambiguous mappings; never guess.

DAT-034.definition: **DAT-034 MUST** make migration idempotent and test fixtures for:

DAT-040.definition: **DAT-040 MUST NOT** include credentials/secrets in ordinary backup/export.

DAT-042.definition: **DAT-042 MUST** protect CSV/spreadsheet exports from formula injection where applicable.

DAT-050.definition: **DAT-050 MUST** keep media blobs separate from high-frequency structured state.

DAT-051.definition: **DAT-051 MUST** revoke temporary Object URLs on close/replace/destroy.

DAT-052.definition: **DAT-052 SHOULD** avoid retaining unlimited original food photos; retain only what the product explicitly needs.

DAT-053.definition: **DAT-053 MUST** store durable user media as separate MediaAsset/blob records referenced by structured domain records rather than duplicating base64 through the entire app state.

DAT-060.definition: **DAT-060 MUST** maintain explicit product/data version truth at least for:

DAT-061.definition: **DAT-061 MUST** detect and safely block/handle invalid version combinations instead of silently running incompatible schema/cache/content mixes.

UX-015.definition: **UX-015 MUST** collect enough initial context to recommend an existing safe preset/profile without inventing an unverified AI program:

UX-020.definition: **UX-020 MUST** make today's workout the dominant action.

UX-022.definition: **UX-022 MUST** show at most a small number of meaningful metrics and one evidence-backed Boji note.

UX-030.definition: **UX-030 MUST** support two user modes without splitting the data model:

UX-060.definition: **UX-060 MUST** use the frozen character direction:

UX-061.definition: **UX-061 MUST** preserve readability and small-size recognizability.

UX-062.definition: **UX-062 MUST NOT** over-sexualize the default character or drift into childlike/underage visual proportions.

UX-073.definition: **UX-073 SHOULD** keep major training touch targets around 44px minimum.

UX-074.definition: **UX-074 MUST** provide persistent, clear error UI for critical storage/migration failures.

PWA-001.definition: **PWA-001 MUST** use GitHub Pages as the primary V2 static PWA delivery path for this scope unless PRE-LUNA evidence requires a documented alternative.

PWA-010.definition: **PWA-010 MUST** isolate V2 RC and V2 Production namespaces for:

PWA-011.definition: **PWA-011 MUST NOT** delete caches outside the app's managed namespace.

PWA-012.definition: **PWA-012 MUST** keep V1 data namespaces read-only.

PWA-013.definition: **PWA-013 MUST** define distinct PWA identity for RC and Production, including manifest `id`, `start_url`, `scope`, `name/short_name`, standalone display and required 192/512 icons.

PWA-014.definition: **PWA-014 SHOULD** request persistent browser storage (`navigator.storage.persist()` or equivalent) when supported. Denial MUST NOT break the app; Data Health should make the storage/backup state understandable.

PWA-015.definition: **PWA-015 MAY** use Screen Wake Lock during an active workout as a best-effort convenience. Wake Lock MUST NOT be a correctness dependency.

PWA-016.definition: **PWA-016 MUST** coordinate multiple tabs/windows so only one owner can mutate the active workout. A second tab is read-only unless the user explicitly takes over ownership.

REL-001.definition: **REL-001 MUST** treat RC and Production as separate install identities/scopes.

REL-002.definition: **REL-002 MUST** allow automated execution to produce only RC artifacts.

REL-003.definition: **REL-003 MUST NOT** generate or claim final Production approval before independent qualification.

PWA-020.definition: **PWA-020 MUST** support project-page subpaths and verify:

PWA-030.definition: **PWA-030 MUST** bind background cache refresh to service-worker lifetime where needed.

PWA-031.definition: **PWA-031 MUST** avoid forcing disruptive update/reload during active workout, migration, or critical commit.

PWA-032.definition: **PWA-032 MUST** scope cache cleanup to managed prefixes and use service-worker lifetime control (`event.waitUntil` or equivalent) for background update work that must complete reliably.

PWA-033.definition: **PWA-033 MUST** pause noncritical animation/polling when hidden and recompute wall-clock-derived state on resume rather than replaying missed timer ticks.

PWA-040.definition: **PWA-040 MUST** preserve core local functionality offline:

RUN-010.definition: **RUN-010 MUST** treat foreground GPS as the baseline claim.

RUN-011.definition: **RUN-011 MUST NOT** claim reliable background/locked-screen GPS without physical-device evidence.

RUN-012.definition: **RUN-012 MUST** preserve route first/last points during simplification.

RUN-013.definition: **RUN-013 MUST** avoid full-page rerender on every running tick; update only live fields/path.

RUN-014.definition: **RUN-014 MUST** show a gap/manual fallback when GPS continuity is unavailable; it MUST NOT invent/interpolate a route and present it as measured.

PWA-050.definition: **PWA-050 MUST** give long-running async UI work explicit ownership and staleness control (cancellation and/or generation/request id). A response from an obsolete view/query MUST NOT overwrite newer state.

SEC-001.definition: **SEC-001 MUST NOT** expose provider API keys in the static frontend.

SEC-002.definition: **SEC-002 MUST** scan source, build, backup, evidence bundle, and release artifact for secrets.

SEC-010.definition: **SEC-010 MUST NOT** ship known third-party official character assets as the official Boji brand.

SEC-011.definition: **SEC-011 MUST NOT** invent a code/content license. Code license, original character/assets, third-party video/data terms, and any redistribution restrictions must be documented separately according to the owner's actual choice.

REL-004.definition: **REL-004 MUST** prevent failed required tests/gates from deploying an RC or Production artifact.

REL-005.definition: **REL-005 SHOULD** keep incomplete implementation work off the trusted release lineage/main branch; gate-qualified checkpoints may be committed, while HOLD work remains clearly unapproved.

REL-006.definition: **REL-006 MUST** reserve Production tags/releases for post-Luna independent qualification. Automated execution may create only RC-qualified lineage/tags when allowed by the repository workflow.

REL-012.definition: **REL-012 MUST** generate QR from the actual verified deployment URL rather than a separately hard-coded URL string.

TST-001.definition: **TST-001 MUST** add a repository-native Node dependency manifest and committed lockfile for the V2 test harness. Qualified baseline versions are `jsdom 28.1.0` and `qrcode 1.5.4`; other versions require equivalence evidence.

TST-002.definition: **TST-002 MUST** remove hardcoded WorkBuddy/local-machine `NODE_PATH` dependency and use standard project-local Node resolution.

TST-003.definition: **TST-003 MUST** make eval artifact generation deterministic in a clean clone. Generators MUST create required output directories idempotently. J15/K8 prerequisites MUST be generated explicitly or governed as explicit SKIPPED; a skipped prerequisite MUST NOT be counted as a full regression PASS.

TST-004.definition: **TST-004 MUST** remove the local-day-2 F1/F2 fixture bomb without changing production behavior. Prefer choosing the test target from an actually seeded check-in key or using one shared deterministic offset helper.

TST-005.definition: **TST-005 MUST** replace D1's fragile fixed-time assumption with deterministic polling/event-driven waiting where practical. If a timeout remains, it MUST have evidence-based headroom. Product timing MUST NOT be changed merely to satisfy the test.

TST-006.definition: **TST-006 MUST** demonstrate the repaired harness from a fresh disposable clone/workspace with no WorkBuddy-specific path. Acceptance requires dependency install from committed manifest/lockfile, syntax checks, deterministic prerequisite setup, full legacy regression, and repeated runs showing F1/F2/J15/K8/D1 no longer depend on date, prior artifacts, or timing luck.
